serverInfo.name: upos-cloud-pos-mcp
serverInfo.title: UPOS Cloud POS MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for UPOS Cloud POS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers are saved on my POS account?"; "Show the sale report for my store for the last 7 days."; "List the taxes and menu items of my store.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes UPOS Cloud POS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run uposcloudpos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run uposcloudpos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run uposcloudpos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. uposcloudpos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers saved on the account (loyalty and contact records). UPOS API: GET /customers.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer record by customer id. UPOS API: GET /customer/{customer-id}.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_customer_loyalties
tools.title: Get customer loyalties
tools.description: Get the loyalty balances and programs of one customer. UPOS API: GET /customer/{customer-id}/getCustomerLoyalties.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record on the account. Only the fields you pass are sent. UPOS API: POST /customer.

membership_plan_id.description: Membership plan id (Membership tab in the back office).

tools.name: uposcloudpos_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: WRITE: update one customer record. Only the fields you pass are sent. UPOS API: PUT /customer/{customer-id}.

membership_plan_id.description: Membership plan id (Membership tab in the back office).

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_store_users
tools.title: List store users
tools.description: List the users (staff) of one store. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/users.

store_id.description: Store id. Omit to use the store set for this connection.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user (staff member) by user id. UPOS API: GET /user/{user-id}.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_taxes
tools.title: List taxes
tools.description: List the taxes of one store. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/taxes.

store_id.description: Store id. Omit to use the store set for this connection.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_menu_items
tools.title: List menu items
tools.description: List the menu items of one store (items sold on the POS). UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/menuItems.

store_id.description: Store id. Omit to use the store set for this connection.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_sale_report
tools.title: Sale report
tools.description: Read the department and category sale report of one store for a date range. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/saleReport.

store_id.description: Store id. Omit to use the store set for this connection.

date_option.description: Date range: T today, Y yesterday, LND last N days (needs number_of_days), W this week, L7D last 7 days, M this month, LM last month, L30D last 30 days, SD one specific date (needs specific_date), DR date range (needs from_date and to_date).

number_of_days.description: Days back, for date option LND.

specific_date.description: Date for date option SD, format dd-Mon-yyyy (for example 29-Sep-2019).

from_date.description: Start date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.

to_date.description: End date for date option DR, format dd-Mon-yyyy.
